**Lead the Transformation. Own the Floor. Elevate Manufacturing Excellence.**
  

 Our client is a fast\-growing multinational packaging manufacturer entering an exciting phase of multi\-site expansion and full digital transformation. This is a high\-accountability, hands\-on leadership role for an operations expert ready to drive a step\-change in performance across a fast\-paced production environment. If you have built your career from the shop floor up and have a passion for operational excellence, this is a permanent opportunity that will challenge and reward in equal measure.
   

  

**Why Apply?**
  

 This is more than a manufacturing role \- it is a chance to shape a five\-year growth agenda for a business with serious ambitions. You will have full operational ownership, the platform to embed world\-class lean practices, and the authority to build the next generation of manufacturing leadership. For the right person, this is a career\-defining move.
   

  

**The Role**
  

 Driving operational excellence across multi\-site manufacturing:
 


* Own full P\&L accountability for all production operations across multiple UAE sites
* Champion lean transformation, driving OEE gains, waste elimination, and consistent process standards
* Spearhead SAP integration and real\-time digital manufacturing adoption across all shop\-floor operations
* Ensure full compliance with FSSC, ISO, safety, and customer quality standards
* Oversee engineering, maintenance, and capex delivery, including capacity expansion and layout changes
* Identify and develop the next tier of operational leaders, building a culture rooted in discipline and customer accountability







**What We're Looking For**
  

 A hands\-on, process\-driven leader with a track record of delivering results at scale:
 


* 25\+ years in manufacturing, with at least 10 years in a senior leadership role
* Background in rigid plastic packaging manufacturing \- ISBM, two\-stage, EBM, or IM processes
* Lean/Six Sigma expertise \- Black Belt preferred
* Proven SAP manufacturing digitisation experience
* Demonstrated multi\-site operations leadership
* A natural coach who builds accountability and drives performance through people







 Ready to take ownership? Apply now.

data.jd_text:
Welcome to MultiBank Group, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting\-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.
 



  





 Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18\+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Head of AI, Data \& Governance will lead MultiBank Group's enterprise\-wide Artificial Intelligence, Data Management, Data Governance, and Analytics strategy. This strategic leadership role is responsible for establishing a modern data\-driven organization, driving AI adoption across business functions, and ensuring the organization's data assets are governed, secure, reliable, and leveraged effectively to support business growth, operational excellence, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
 



  





 The successful candidate will oversee AI initiatives, enterprise data governance, data architecture, analytics, information management, and data quality programs while leading multidisciplinary teams across Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Governance. This role will serve as a key advisor to executive leadership, ensuring that data and AI capabilities become core enablers of innovation, decision\-making, and competitive advantage.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**AI Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Define and execute the Group\-wide AI strategy aligned with business objectives and long\-term technology vision.
* Lead the development and deployment of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation solutions across business functions.
* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks, model monitoring standards, explainability practices, and responsible AI policies.
* Identify opportunities where AI and advanced analytics can improve client experience, operational efficiency, risk management, compliance monitoring, and revenue growth.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and tools to maintain competitive advantage within the financial services industry.
* Drive adoption of AI\-powered solutions across business, operational, and technology teams.



**Data Strategy \& Management** 



* Define and execute the enterprise data strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Establish data as a strategic organizational asset by promoting data\-driven decision\-making across all business functions.
* Oversee enterprise data architecture, data platforms, data integration, and data lifecycle management.
* Develop scalable frameworks for managing structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data across the organization.
* Drive enterprise\-wide data accessibility, discoverability, and self\-service analytics capabilities.



**Data Governance \& Compliance** 



* Establish and maintain enterprise\-wide data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls.
* Define data ownership, stewardship, quality management, classification, retention, lineage, and access management practices.
* Lead data quality initiatives to improve consistency, reliability, accuracy, and completeness of enterprise data.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, privacy, security, and information governance requirements across all jurisdictions.
* Develop governance frameworks for AI models, training data, model risk management, and responsible AI deployment.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk, Security, and Legal teams to ensure data and AI initiatives meet internal and external regulatory requirements.



**Analytics \& Business Intelligence** 



* Establish enterprise\-wide KPI frameworks, performance measurement standards, and executive reporting capabilities.
* Drive advanced analytics initiatives that support commercial, operational, risk, compliance, and customer\-focused functions.
* Enable business stakeholders with actionable insights through dashboards, reporting platforms, and self\-service analytics solutions.
* Promote data literacy and analytical capabilities across leadership and operational teams.
* Ensure analytics outputs are aligned with strategic business objectives and measurable outcomes.



**Data Platform \& Architecture Oversight** 



* Oversee modern data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and cloud\-based analytics environments.
* Ensure scalability, performance, security, and resilience of enterprise data infrastructure.
* Define standards for data modeling, metadata management, master data management, and enterprise architecture.
* Drive modernization initiatives across the data ecosystem to support future AI and analytics capabilities.



**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams across AI, Data Engineering, Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Governance functions.
* Partner with executive leadership to align AI and data initiatives with corporate strategy and business priorities.
* Establish governance councils, steering committees, and operating models to support enterprise data and AI initiatives.
* Present strategic roadmaps, governance metrics, AI adoption progress, and data maturity assessments to senior leadership.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data ownership, and evidence\-based decision\-making.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




  




* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience across Data, Analytics, AI, Information Management, or Governance disciplines, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven experience developing and executing enterprise AI and data strategies within large\-scale organizations.
* Strong experience establishing and managing enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
* Deep understanding of data quality, metadata management, data lineage, master data management, and information governance principles.
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide data transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Strong expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics methodologies.
* Experience working with cloud\-based data and analytics platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, security, regulatory compliance, and governance requirements within highly regulated industries.
* Experience building and leading multidisciplinary teams across AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance functions.
* Strong understanding of financial services, brokerage, capital markets, trading platforms, CFDs, Forex, Cryptocurrency, or related industries is highly desirable.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




  




* Experience implementing enterprise\-scale Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience establishing Data Governance Councils, Data Stewardship Programs, and Data Quality Frameworks.
* Familiarity with MLOps, model lifecycle management, and production AI deployment practices.
* Proven track record of driving enterprise data culture transformation and increasing organizational data maturity.
* Experience operating within global and highly regulated financial environments.
* Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and strategic planning skills.
* Passion for leveraging AI, data, and governance to drive innovation, operational excellence, and business performance.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  




* Work with an industry\-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.



  





*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.*

**Job Description**
 Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
   

  

 Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e\&), AT\&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
   

  

 Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
   

  

* Circles.Life: A wholly\-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go\-to\-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform\-as\-a\-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud\-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.


 Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are hiring a Head of Commercial to lead and execute the end\-to\-end commercial strategy for a new digital telco brand launching in the MENA region. This is a pivotal leadership role with direct accountability for revenue growth, pricing strategy, customer value management (CVM), and commercial partnerships.
   

  

 As a key member of the founding country leadership team, you will shape the brand’s commercial engine from the ground up, including building the offers, bundles, and monetisation strategies that drive customer acquisition, retention, and profitability in a highly competitive digital environment.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own the commercial strategy and execution: Design and execute the commercial roadmap, from pricing architecture and CVM strategies to growth modeling and competitive differentiation
* Develop compelling product offers: Collaborate closely with the Head of Product and the Circles Global Digital Advisory \& Support Services (“DASS”) Strategy and Value Proposition teams to create customer\-centric propositions, plans, and bundles aligned with market needs, digital habits, and unit economics
* Revenue and profitability ownership: Build business models, track commercial performance, and own P\&L levers to ensure the delivery of strong topline growth and margin discipline, in alignment with commercial targets committed
* Lead pricing and monetization: Establish dynamic pricing strategies based on behavioral insights, market benchmarks, and testing (e.g., conjoint analyses, pricing ladder)
* Lead commercial negotiations: Lead commercial negotiations with partners, payment providers, and digital ecosystem players
* Cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Work closely with product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure commercial goals are embedded across GTM plans and digital journeys

* Proven track record in launching or scaling digital\-first propositions in B2C markets
* Deep understanding of B2C telco P\&L levers, pricing strategy, CVM, and monetization models, including tiered plans, bundling, freemium / upsell, and partner\-based go\-to\-market planning and execution
* Experience working across cross\-functional squads, with strong influence over product, marketing, finance, and channel operations
* MENA experience is strongly preferred; understanding of regulatory dynamics and customer behavior in the region is a plus.
* Operated in fast\-paced, greenfield or high\-growth environments, ideally in MENA.
* Sharp strategic thinker with the execution mindset of a builder, with a strong ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize, and deliver commercial impact for the business


 Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Head of Private Banking Support (HoPBS) function focuses on ex\-ante (preventive) controls to increase effectiveness and ensure consistency in operational processes. It is together with the Local PBCOO and the Head of Private Banking (HoPB) responsible for the First Line of Defense (FLoD) to ensure an effective, risk\-controlled, and regulatory compliant operating environment for the Private Banking function based in Dubai, UAE. Furthermore, PBS contributes to the enhancement of and oversight over the FLoD control environment. In addition, the function is responsible for various topics related to the daily office wide matters, communication, staff training, governance, and office support.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate the control activity in line with the Global Private Banking Control Blueprint, though aligned to local regulatory requirements
* Actively identify, manage, and mitigate risks arising from business operations including but not limited to AML/KYC risk, cross border, and suitability.
* Assure quality and timeliness of the activities performed by the frontline such as the content of Client Information Profiles (CIP), account documentations and periodic relationship reviews
* Approve the periodic relationship, business introducer and independent asset managers reviews and CIP modifications as well as new standard risk accounts in accordance with the authority delegated by HoPB, and ensure sufficient oversight in the area
* Keep track of the timely completion of pending items (follow\-ups) and remediation of issues related to client lifecycle activities
* Proactively collect feedback from the frontline to improve the efficiency of the day\-to\-day operations
* Successfully manage internal audits and operational risk Incidents


**Management \& Leadership**
* Demonstrate exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Values and Code of Conduct
* Lead the team of PBS to drive client\-centric process enhancements to improve better client experience, higher service standards, operation efficiency and productivity of the frontline
* Plan and coordinate activities of the team in line with global standards, and sets clear team goals to ensure staff have clarity of roles and responsibilities
* Ensure the competence of staff members with necessary skills to perform the roles
* Groom the staff through various exposure in meeting/project involvement, coaching and mentoring
* Identity relevant training/industry seminars, etc suitable for staff
* member to attend
* Monitor team performance, regular feedback given, and
* performance appraised fairly
* Motivate team members and ensure teamwork, guided by EFG
* corporate values to build a strong positive culture


**Other Tasks**
* Continuously maintain and improve effective communication with the three lines of defence to ensure compliance with the latest regulatory standard.
* Work jointly with local Business Risk Management (BRM) and Global PBS to smoothen operational processes without compromising the control effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate PB representation in Risk and Compliance governance committees.
* Provide on\-going training to new and existing CROs and CSOs on systems, processes, and policies.
* Collaborate with the Global Head of PBS in the review and refinement of the FLoD framework.
* Any ad\-hoc tasks assigned by the Head of PB (“HoPB”) or the Global Head of PBS.
* Advise, check and validate payments and securities transfers.

**Role       : Head of Products and Value Proposition \- Business Banking**
**Location : Dubai** 
                          
   

  

**Role Purpose:**
 Develop products strategy and commercialization of business banking solutions that focus on SME customers’ needs while optimizing the revenue, cost savings, and customer experience initiatives. In addition to leading the articulation and execution of segmentation, value propositions, pricing, and go\-to\-market plans. The role encompasses the following: 
   

  

* Strategy development, improvement, and implementation
* Product development and value proposition enhancement
* Segment management and commercialization
* Cross\-Selling \& product penetration:
* Digital transformation
* Collaboration with fintech and ecosystem partners.
* Adoption of emerging technologies:
* Continuous innovation
* Customer experience enhancements
* Training and sales support


  

  

 Head of Products and Value Proposition is accountable for managing the full product lifecycle while ensuring that the products are offered in harmony with effective and efficient customer’s journey, which require thought leadership in partnership with BBD, GTB, Channels, ITD, Operations, Marketing, Sharia, Compliance, ICD, Vendors, Government Entities, etc.
   

  

**KEY METRICS:**
* **Revenue:** 
 BBD top line revenue across all products lines (NRFF and Fee Income)
* **Development:** 
 Manage system changes and projects of BBD
* **Commercialization:** 
 Define business opportunities and provide sales support deliverables
* **Migration to digital channels:** 
 Increase ADIB Direct customer’s utilization and increase digital onboarding


  

  

**Key Accountabilities of the role**
**Strategy Development, Improvement, and Implementation**
* Develop the strategic vision and aspirations as well as drive strategic imperatives.
* Identify, analyze and prioritize growth opportunities for the business.
* Define, drive and monitor the strategic projects portfolio.
* Monitor progress against priorities and recommend any required shifts in the strategy.
* Analyze segments, sales and channels performance in order to develop new or fine\-tune existing segment strategies.


  

  

**Product Development and Value proposition Enhancement**
* Manage and enhance pricing and offerings of business liabilities \& cash fees (across BBD segments), business finance products (under SBF/ Tier 0 \- excluding GTB products), to ensure they compete effectively.
* Own and develop the range of products offered to business banking customers via alternative channels.
* Conceptualize new product ideas and evaluate them objectively from a market and financial standpoint.
* Working closely with BBD to explore, identify and qualify/quantify new solution that could materially impact positively Business Banking customers, based on eligibility and proper segmentation.
* Develop and drive specific commercialization activities creating tools to support Business Banking sales effort.
* Develop frameworks, processes, and models to support the activities of the BBD strategies.


  

  

**Segment Management and Commercialization**
* Analyze markets and products to identify business opportunities and generate new business ideas
* Amplify ADIB Business value proposition and visibility through campaigns and promotions, and propose media campaigns and promotions for increased sales
* Initiate the B2B Marketing initiatives of Business Banking including communications, digital marketing campaigns, ATL marketing campaigns, webinars, events, and PR activities
* Ensure that all campaigns are well aligned to the Business Banking customer segments and marketing strategies
* Ensure adequate product visibility and manage the media planning and liaison with central marketing dept.
* Promote product awareness via appropriate external and internal communication, training, and marketing collaterals
* Continuously track the market trends and identify customer needs and build profitable proposition to address the segment needs.
* Ensure customer insights are utilized effectively to build strategic and tactical direction of the product strategy.
* Analyze markets and products to identify business opportunities and generate new business ideas.
* Recommend pricing and charges based on market analysis while ensuring it is consistent with the product strategy.


  

  

**Drive Continuous Innovation:**
* Foster culture of innovation by encouraging cross\-functional collaboration and agile methodologies to accelerate the delivery of impactful digital solutions.
* Stay ahead of evolving market trends, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations to ensure Business Banking proposition remains competitive and future\-ready.


  

  

**Enhance Customer Experience**
* Focus on delivering customer\-centric onboarding experiences that cater to the unique needs of SME clients.
* Implement feedback loops and continuous improvement mechanisms to adapt products and services to evolving customer demands.


  

  

**Training and Sales Support**
* Provide regular product training to Business Banking front\-liners, RMs and Sales.
* Communicate products, delivery channels updates, ensuring clear understanding of product capabilities across various customer touch\-points, including sales, relationship managers, implementation, etc.


  

  

**Enhance Cross\-Selling \& Product Penetration:**
* Develop and implement data\-driven cross\-selling strategies to increase product penetration across the SME client base.
* Identify and lead cross\-selling opportunities based on eligibility and most responsive profiles.
* Leverage channels to identify cross\-selling opportunities, recommend relevant solutions, and enhance wallet share.
* Collaborate with sale and relationship management teams to design offerings that cater to SME client needs.
* Track performance metrics and continuously optimize cross\-selling campaigns to achieve revenue growth targets.


  

  

**Lead Digital Transformation:**
* Drive end\-to\-end digital initiatives for SME Customer onboarding journeys with focus on efficiency, scalability, and a seamless customer experience
* Digitize key touchpoints across SME customer lifecycle, ensuring seamless integrations with digital channels


  

  

**Collaborate with Fintech and Ecosystem Partners:**
* Partner with leading fintechs, licensing bodies, and ecosystem players to co\-create innovative solutions that enhance customer onboarding and product accessibility.
* Leverage strategic collaborations to streamline processes, improve compliance and risk management frameworks.


  

  

**Adopt Emerging Technologies:**
* Integrate advanced technologies such as AI, machine learning, open banking, etc.
* Utilize data analytics to optimize processes, reduce turnaround times, and improve the over customer journeys.


  

  

**Specialist Skills / Technical Knowledge Required for this role:**
  
   

  

* Post graduate degree from a reputable institution in addition to any Specialized certification preferably in one of the related domains such as in cash management, project management, etc.
* Strong understanding of transaction banking solutions that suit Business Banking Segments.
* Team management experience with ability to mentor, coach and motivate a team of product managers.
* Entrepreneurial ability and energy to visualize, develop and execute plans.
* Ability to work comfortably with different cultures, backgrounds and skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of complex projects, business initiatives and transformation programs.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams without formal authority.
* Strong written and verbal presentation skills, particularly in synthesizing large amounts of information into concise messaging for executive management consumption.
* Bilingual is preferred but not a must (English, Arabic).

 As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for an exceptional AI Transformation Director to lead our enterprise\-wide AI transformation and help build one of the Middle East’s first truly AI\-native organizations.
 



 This role goes far beyond implementing AI tools. You will define how AI becomes embedded into every aspect of our business, from business development and creative operations to finance, HR, project delivery, procurement and executive decision\-making.

 Lead the transformation of Alsayegh Group into an AI\-first enterprise by designing, implementing and scaling AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

* Develop and execute the Group’s AI transformation strategy.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI opportunities across all business units.
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions that automate and enhance business processes.
* Build AI\-powered workflows that integrate with our existing technology ecosystem.
* Establish AI governance, security and responsible AI frameworks.
* Partner with executive leadership to embed AI into strategic decision\-making.
* Build and lead an internal AI team while managing external technology partners where appropriate.
* Foster an AI\-driven culture through education, change management and continuous innovation.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide AI or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, automation platforms, AI orchestration and enterprise AI architectures.
* Experience integrating AI with CRM, ERP, project management and collaboration platforms.
* Ability to bridge business strategy with technology execution.
* Exceptional leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building new capabilities from the ground up.
* Experience in consulting, enterprise technology, AI startups or large\-scale transformation programs is highly desirable.



  





**Bonus Experience:** 




 Experience in one or more of the following industries is a plus:
 


* Marketing \& Communications
* Events \& Live Experiences
* Exhibitions
* FF\&E
* Fit\-Out

**Why Join Us:** 




 This is a unique opportunity to build something from the ground up.
 



  





 You won’t be joining an AI team. You’ll be creating it.

 If you’re passionate about building the next generation of AI\-powered organizations and want to make a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Summary:** 
 The Chief Investment \& Finance Officer (CIFO) reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and serves as the CEO's principal deputy on all investment and financial matters. The role combines strategic investment management with corporate finance leadership and is responsible for maximizing shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation, financial stewardship, and execution of the Company's investment strategy.
 



**Tasks and Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Investment Management** 




**Investment Strategy** 



* Develop, maintain, and monitor the Company's long\-term investment strategy, ensuring alignment with the Board\-approved strategic plan.
* Establish measurable investment objectives and report progress against approved targets.
* Monitor market, industry, and macroeconomic developments to identify opportunities and emerging risks.



**Portfolio Management** 



* Prepare quarterly investment reports covering:
* Performance against approved targets.
* Financial performance and valuation.
* Approved key risk indicators.
* Cash flow performance.
* Return on investment.
* Strategic positioning.
* Growth potential (BCG Growth\-Share Matrix).
* Value enhancement and corrective action recommendations.



**Investment Pipeline** 



* Maintain a structured pipeline of investment opportunities.
* Provide quarterly updates on opportunities reviewed, investment rationale, due diligence outcomes, rejected opportunities, and recommendations for shortlisted investments.



**Strategic Investments** 



* Lead the execution and monitoring of up to three major strategic investments.
* Ensure investments are expected to generate returns above the Company's weighted average cost of capital over an average five\-year period.
* Develop and monitor performance improvement plans with the ENRC, where required.



**Portfolio Review** 



* Conduct periodic reviews of all investments.
* For investments projected to generate returns below 10% p.a. over five years, develop recovery plans or recommend divestment/exit strategies within five years.



**Greenfield \& Brownfield Investments** 



* Maintain at least one active Greenfield or Brownfield investment opportunity.
* Develop business cases, implementation plans, value creation plans, and exit strategies before approval.
* Ensure an expected investment exit horizon of approximately five years.



  





**2\. Finance Leadership** 




**Financial Planning \& Analysis** 



* Lead annual budgeting, long\-term financial planning, rolling forecasts, and scenario analysis across portfolio companies.
* Monitor performance against budgets and recommend corrective actions.



**Treasury \& Cash Flow Management** 



* Monitor forward\-looking cash flows and identify funding gaps proactively.
* Present financing and liquidity management strategies to the ENRC.
* Optimize capital allocation across the portfolio.



**Financial Reporting** 



* Ensure timely preparation of quarterly Board reports and annual statutory financial statements.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, regulatory requirements, and corporate governance standards.



**Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Maintain effective internal controls and strengthen financial governance.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations.



**Commercial \& Contract Review** 



* Review significant commercial contracts and investment agreements.
* Assess financial implications and risks prior to execution.
* Support negotiations of strategic commercial arrangements.



**Banking \& Financing** 



* Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing, and capital\-raising activities.
* Negotiate financing facilities and optimize borrowing costs.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* CFA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA, or equivalent internationally recognized professional qualification.
* MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Investment, or Business Administration.
 *(Preferred)*
* Mechanical or Industrial Engineering qualification in addition to finance credentials.
 *(Preferred)*
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior executive leadership role.
* Experience within an investment company, sovereign wealth fund, private equity firm, investment holding company, or diversified industrial group.
* Proven experience in investment portfolio evaluation and management.
* Experience leading mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
* Strong expertise in corporate finance, valuation, financial modelling, and capital allocation.
* Experience working with Boards of Directors and Board Committees.
* Experience within industrial manufacturing businesses is highly desirable.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
* The Director of Transition Finance and Advisory (TFA) (Market) role is responsible for acting as the primary sustainable finance and transition advisory point of contact for bankers and clients in the market. The role translates global frameworks, thematic insights and bank capabilities into credible client positioning and executable financing pathways. The role focuses on Origination, Client Engagement and Content Creation with a focus on driving commercial impact.
* This role will work in close partnership with Coverage and Risk teams, brings sector insight, disciplined judgement, and cross‑border connectivity to deliver sustainable growth across the Transition Finance and Advisory portfolio.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Support origination and execution of Sustainable and Transition Finance transactions**
**Sustainable Finance** 
 (SF)
 **Products’ origination** 
 (including RFPs), with a focus on:
   

  

* Increasing awareness of SF offerings and benefits among underpenetrated clients (solution replicability).
* Winning new businesses where ESG can differentiate the bank (e.g. SF coordinator role) vs. competing primarily on balance sheet size and pricing, such as ESG structured notes).
* Identifying client opportunities for distribution of the bank’s sustainable finance assets.
* SF product execution / structuring, where agreed with Products and the bank is SF coordinator. Focus on expansion of our sustainability\-linked framework to consider additional / novel KPIs.
* Work with targeted (less sophisticated) clients on SF / Transition frameworks when clear monetisation opportunities (first SLL deal, capturing conventional client SoW)
* Work with the Global Transition Technologies teams to originate Energy Transition transactions across our markets. Three areas of focus:
* Capital partnerships: preferred origination partner to large energy\-transition funds and sovereign platforms (through partnerships)
* Platform story: package Energy Transition as a repeatable consolidation as platform creation is becoming more common in this next phase of fragmented energy transition market consolidation (becoming PP)
* Partner to governments on capital mobilization (incl. Sponsors): decarbonization, energy, and minerals security with increased state co\-funding and de\-risking.


**Contribute to content\-led client engagements with clear monetisation opportunities**
* Leverage content and expertise to contribute to high‑quality client engagements that lead to tangible revenue outcomes, including direct contribution to transition and sustainable finance transactions, origination support, and expansion of client wallet share.


**Thought leadership and proprietary content development**
* Develop understanding of market specific SF developments (incl. emerging E\&S risk themes and ‘hot spots’, SF market trends and product uptakes), and how this will impact our clients and client insights.
* Develop sector\-specific content:
* Covering ESG thematic / trends / market dynamics, peer benchmarking, product benchmarking / recent transactions / case studies
* Producing analysis and content around ESG risks and controversies impacting resilience, and investor confidence
* Incorporating Transition tech (e.g. SAF) and Capital Structure considerations
* Leveraging relevant thematic from CSO Innovation Hubs (e.g. Carbon, Nature)


 Support brand building and profiling: Participate in relevant industry initiatives to gather relevant market intelligence, demonstrate thought leadership, and maintain client connectivity.
   

  

 Strengthen governance, risk discipline, and role clarity: Act as first line accountable leader for conduct, reputational, and advisory risks within the mandate. Ensure teams operate within defined frameworks, avoid greenwashing risk, and maintain clear boundaries with Coverage, Products, and regulatory functions.
   

  

 Adhere to values \& conduct expectations (non\-negotiable): By role\-modelling ethical conduct, risk discipline, client suitability, inclusion, and enterprise first leadership.
   

  

**Measure of Success**
* Direct contribution to SF \& TF transactions: the team will work towards a target direct dollar contribution to SF / TF transactions.
* Client income contribution: the team will work towards a dollar client income contribution amount tagged to an agreed list of clients that have been identified as having a strong opportunity for increased share of wallet.
* High\-quality client engagements: the team will work towards a specified number of target client engagements to be completed within an agreed time period. These client engagements will be focused on where there is a real opportunity to drive commercial impact.
* Marketing activities: the team will work towards producing an agreed amount of thought leadership pieces of content and participation in key industry forums.


**Skills And Experience**
* Sustainable and Transition Finance
* Climate Transition and Decarbonization
* Financing and Structured Solutions
* Business Development
* Corporate Finance
* Financial Analysis
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Regulatory Environment – Financial Services


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**
* Experience in sustainable finance, ESG or transition advisory across sectors and markets, with the ability to translate policy, transition and ESG developments into financially and credit\-relevant insights.
* Track record of developing scalable sector narratives, analytical insights or flagship content, and of shaping frameworks or methodologies used across regions.
* Experience supporting complex or novel sustainable or transition finance situations, influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Credit, CSO and Coverage in matrixed environments


**Certifications / Qualifications**
* Advanced knowledge of sustainable and transition finance concepts, market standards and emerging practices, gained through professional experience or formal training.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

 Every essence of you enriches our world. Diversity drives innovation and creates closer connections with our employees, customers and partners. Givaudan embraces diversity and is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone impacts our world.

data.jd_text:
هدف الوظيفة
   

  

 يكون مدير إدارة المعايير والسياسات مسؤولاً عن ضمان مواءمة الهيئة مع أحدث المتطلبات التنظيمية، وقيادة وتطوير وتحديث وثائق الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام (بما في ذلك السياسات، والمتطلبات، والمعايير، وإجراءات العمل الموحدة، وغيرها)، وإعداد إطار ضوابط خط الدفاع الثاني، ومراجعة مجموعة ضوابط الهيئة المتعلقة بمخاطر الالتزام الأساسية مثل الرشوة والفساد، والتداول في السوق المالية بناءً على المعلومات الداخلية للشركات المدرجة، وغسل الأموال وتمويل الإرهاب، وتعارض المصالح، والتغييرات التنظيمية.
   

  

 الأدوار والمسؤوليات
   

  

* المشاركة في تطوير خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام وضمان التوافق مع استراتيجية الهيئة
* تطوير الخطة التشغيلية لإدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام ومواءمتها مع خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام، والخطة الاستراتيجية لوكالة الشؤون القانونية والالتزام.
* المشاركة في تطوير خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام وضمان التوافق مع استراتيجية الهيئة
* تطوير الخطة التشغيلية لإدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام ومواءمتها مع خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام، والخطة الاستراتيجية لوكالة الشؤون القانونية والالتزام.
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة بما يتعلق بالمعايير والسياسات ، لتطبيقها في الهيئة
* تنفيذ الخطط وتزويد المدخلات اللازمة للتمكن من تحقيق أهداف إدارة المعايير والسياسات التي تدعم الأهداف الاستراتيجية الشاملة للهيئة
* مناقشة متطلبات الميزانية المالية مع الإدارة العليا وتزويد المدخلات المتعلقة بعمليات إعدادها
* ضمان الاستخدام الأمثل لميزانية إدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام وتقديم تقرير دقيق عن التقدّم
* التحقق من المبادرات، والتوصية بالمبادرات التي تؤدي إلى تحقيق نتائج إيجابية لإدارة المعايير والسياسات، وتخفف من حدة المخاطر المالية والتشغيلية والتنظيمية.
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة لتحديد/متابعة الالتزامات الوطنية/الدولية الجديدة و/أو المعدلة الخاصة بالالتزام التنظيمي (ومن ذلك الأمور التشريعية والتعاقدية، وما يتعلق بالنظام العام، والأوامر السامية، والاتفاقيات المبرمة مع الجهات الدولية، والالتزامات العادلة، والقواعد والمعايير الإلزامية ذات الصلة بالقطاع، والسياسات والقواعد التنظيمية وغير ذلك) من أجل المحافظة على معرفة آخر المستجدات المتعلقة بالأنظمة و/أو اللوائح التنظيمية و/أو المتطلبات الوطنية و/أو الدولية لتطبيقها في هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك
* التنسيق مع وكالة التواصل المؤسسي والتوعية بشأن الأنظمة واللوائح والمتطلبات الجديدة/ المحدثة (الخارجية والداخلية) من خلال إحاطات الاجتماعات أو الخطابات أو المذكرات أو الرسائل الإلكترونية أو غير ذلك من الصيغ التي تهدف إلى رفع مستوى الوعي
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة من أجل تقييم الأثر وتحديث السياسات/المعايير/الإجراءات ذات الصلة وتنفيذ واجبات الالتزام الجديدة أو المعدلة
* إجراء البحوث والمقارنات المعيارية لأفضل الممارسات (كل سنة على الأقل) بُغية تحسين الممارسات الحالية ذات الصلة بإطار/سياسة الالتزام في هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك لجميع السياسات والإجراءات الوظيفية الموحدة لإدارة الحوكمة والالتزام
* تولي مسؤولية مكتبة وثائق إدارة الحوكمة والالتزام ومراجعتها دوريًا (كل سنة على الأقل)، ومن ذلك ملاءمة أنواع الوثائق المشمولة واكتمالها وتصنيف الوثائق وضمان جودتها؛ حيثما ينطبق، تحديد الفجوات ومجالات التحسين مثل إعداد وثائق داخلية جديدة للإدارة العامة الحوكمة والالتزام أو مراجعة الوثائق الحالية (مثل السياسات والمعايير وإجراءات العمل الموحدة وغير ذلك) إلى جانب خطط العمل اللازمة

* تحديد متطلبات ضوابط الالتزام لخطي الدفاع الأول والثاني فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التي تقع ضمن إطار مخاطر الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام

data.jd_text:
**About MS Pharma**
 MS Pharma is a leading pharmaceutical company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of generic and biosimilar medicines. Founded in 1989, with headquarters in Amman, Jordan and a Corporate Management Office in Zug, Switzerland, MS Pharma operates across 12 countries with more than 2,000 employees serving patients throughout the Middle East, North Africa, and selected European markets.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Responsible for leading the technical support team to deliver exceptional customer service and resolve all technical issues, as well as maintaining the IT Infrastructure, computer systems, and servers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and maintain the organization's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, hardware, software, email systems, and internet connectivity, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Lead IT operations by providing timely technical support, resolving system issues, and implementing preventive measures to minimize downtime.
* Develop, implement, and monitor IT policies, security controls, and disaster recovery measures to ensure data security, confidentiality, compliance, and business continuity.
* Plan, manage, and oversee IT projects, digital transformation initiatives, and system upgrades in alignment with business objectives and budgets.
* Manage the IT budget, procurement activities, vendor relationships, maintenance contracts, and technology investments to optimize cost and performance.
* Lead, coach, and develop the IT team by assigning priorities, monitoring performance, and promoting continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with business units to identify technology requirements, recommend solutions, and improve operational efficiency across the organization.
* Monitor system performance, analyze trends, conduct periodic audits, and prepare reports on IT operations, security, compliance, and key performance indicators.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, cGMP requirements, applicable regulations, and industry standards while maintaining confidentiality in all IT activities.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* BSc. in Information Technology, computer science or any related field as per the country regulations.
* A minimum of Eight years of relevant experience.
* Proficiency in written, read and spoken Arabic and English Languages.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders.
* HR Systems
* Manufacturing \& Quality Systems
* Knowledge in SQL, Oracle
* GMP
* Project Management
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, including networking, server management.


**Our Culture**
 At MS Pharma, we are guided by our Triple T values:
   

  

* Take Charge – Lead with accountability and courage
* Together for Better – Collaborate with trust and respect
* Thrive – Drive innovation, growth, and continuous improvement


**Job Location:** 
 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 Be part of a purpose\-driven organization committed to improving patients’ lives through high\-quality pharmaceutical solutions and operational excellence.
